tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum bsdus pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sha ta sa ha sri ka pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i don ma nor bar bsdus pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ bka' yang dag pa'i sems shin tu rnam par grol ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ rab 'byor dang*/ kun dga' bo la sogs pa'i lha dang*/ mi la sogs pa'i sems can mtha' yas pas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la 'od zer bye ba drug cu gzigs shing 'phros par gyur to// de nas mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mngon par rab tu brgyan par gyur to// tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis phyag phul zhing*/ mchod pa'i rnam grangs bstan te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rnams la bka' stsal pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ rab 'byor dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba/ de bzhin du khyod rnams spobs par gyis shig /yul drug dang*/ phung po lnga'o// gzugs dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa dang*/ skye mched bcu gnyis dang*/

dbang po drug go /mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ lce dang*/ lus dang*/ yid dang*/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya dang*/ chos so// rnam par shes pa'i don ni/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang*/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ sna'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ lce'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang*/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang*/ reg pa'i don ni/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa dang*/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang*/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang*/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang*/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang*/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang*/ reg pa'i rkyen gyi tshor ba'i don ni/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang*/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang*/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang*/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang*/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang*/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang*/ khams drug gi don ni/ sa'i khams dang*/ chu'i khams dang*/ me'i khams dang*/ rlung gi khams dang*/ nam mkha'i khams dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dang*/ rten cing 'grel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis kyi don ni/ ma rig pa dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa dang*/ ming dang gzugs dang*/ skye mched drug dang*/ reg pa dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ sred pa dang*/ len pa dang*/ srid pa dang*/ skye ba dang*/ rga shi dang*/ byed pa po'i skye mched bcu gnyis kyi don ni/ bdag dang*/ sems can dang*/ srog dang*/ 'gro ba dang*/ gso ba dang*/ skyes bu dang*/ gang zag dang*/ shed can dang*/ shad bdag dang*/ byed pa po dang*/ tshor ba po dang*/ shes pa po dang*/ mthong ba po dang*/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams yod do// rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do// sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams yod do// mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do// dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do// 'phrul dga' ba'i lha rnams yod do// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do// gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi lha rnams yod do// tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do// tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do// tshangs pa kun 'khor kyi lha rnams yod do// snang ba'i lha rnams yod do// 'od snang ba'i lha rnams yod do// tshad med snang ba'i lha rnams yod do// kun tu snang ba'i lha rnams yod do// dge ba'i lha rnams yod do// chung dge'i lha rnams yod do// tshad med dge ba'i lha rnams yod do// tshad med che ba'i lha rnams yod do// 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do// mi che ba'i lha rnams yod do// mi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do// gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams yod do// shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do// 'og min gyi lha rnams yod do// gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i lha rnams yod do// nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do// rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do// cung zad med pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do// 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do// sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/

tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ nang stong pa nyid dang*/ phyi stong pa nyid dang*/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dang*/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ chen po stong pa nyid dang*/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dang*/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang*/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang*/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang*/ thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang*/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang*/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang*/ dbang po lnga dang*/ stobs lnga dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang*/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dang*/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rnams dang*/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i don bstan pa ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs rnam par dag pa dang*/ tshor ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'du shes rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'du byed rnam par dag pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ mig rnam par dag pa dang*/ rna ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ sna rnam par dag pa dang*/ lce rnam par dag pa dang*/ lus rnam par dag pa dang*/

yid rnam par dag pa dang*/ rab 'byor gzhan yang gzugs yongs su dag pa/ gzugs yongs su dag pas/ sgra yongs su dag pa/ sgra yongs su dag pas/ dri yongs su dag pa/ dri yongs su dag pas/ ro yongs su dag pa/ ro yongs su dag pas/ reg yongs su dag pa/ reg yongs su dag pas/ chos yongs su dag pa/ chos yongs su dag pas// mig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su rnam par dag pa nas/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su rnam par dag pa'o// mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang*/ byams pa chen po dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ dga' ba chen po dang*/ btang snyoms chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang*/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang*/ dgra bcom pa nyid dang*/ rang byang chub dang*/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ 'das pa'i dus ma thogs ma chags pa'i ye shes gzigs par 'jug go /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor de dag dang*/ rab 'byor dang*/ kun dga' bo dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi dge slong gi dge 'dun dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri za dang*/ grul bum dang*/ lto 'phye chen por bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum chen moshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i don ma nor bar bsdus pa'i glegs bam dang*/ sh+lau ka dang bam po dang*/ sh+lau ka bkod pa 'di bris na/ yum chen mo bris par 'gyur ro// 'chang na yum chen mo 'chang bar 'gyur ro// sngon rgan rgon rgyu med pa gnyis yod par 'dug pa la/ khang gnya' na grub thob bzang po gcig bzhugs pa des/ khang zhabs su 'dug pa'i rgan rgon gnyis gnang nyin pas mi tsho mi snang ba snying rje re/

'bum brgya tshar gcig dang*/ chu gtor 'bum ther cig byas na tshe ring bar 'dug gsung phrin rgan rgon gnyis po des tshor ba dang*/ sdug nas nam 'chi bsam nas yod dus na/ bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byon nas ldom bu phul byas tsa na/ rgan rgon gnyis pos ldom bu 'bul rgyu med/ deng rang gnyis gnang nyin pas tshe med 'chi ba yin zer/ tshe ring ba la 'bum brgya gcig dang*/ chu gtor gcig bya dgos zer ba la rgyu med pas/ khong rang la ldom bu 'bul rgyu med zhus tsa na/ snying re rje gsungs nas/ 'bum bris pa dang*/ mchod gnas la 'bum brgya byed chug gsungs/ rtsam pa e yod gsungs nas/ chu gtor 'bum ther khong rang gis mdzad pa dang*/ rgan rgon gnyis po tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ rgyu yod pa rnams chos des yong gsungs so// yum chen mo 'bum chung stong phrag brgya pa'i phan yon rdzogs so// yang 'gyur cig na/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rgyal po bi sa ra dang*/ btsun mo ma ga ti gnyis la sras dge chen bya ba cig yod pa de bar chad kyis zin nas/ 'chi la thug pa'i dus su/ rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du myur bar byon nas/ smre sngags bton te/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bdag la bu gcig po zhig mchis pa de bar chad kyis zin nas/ 'chi la thug pa lags/ de mi 'chi ba'i thabs shig bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ rgyal po yar dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ rigs drug tshims pa'i chab gtor dang*/ rgyas pa 'bum brgya tshar nyin gcig la bton na/ dus min 'chi ba las zlog cing nad las grol bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyas pa'i 'bum brgya tshar nyin gcig la thon pa'i thabs bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'bum chung 'di bka' bstsal pa dang*/ rgyal pos 'bum chung 'di myur bar bsgrags so// rgyal bu nad las grol nas/

longs spyod che zhing tshe ring ba dang*/ rgyal khams bde zhing lo phyugs legs pa dang*/ rgyal srid dar bar gyur to// gzhan yang phan yon mtha' yas so// jo bo rjes bal po a su la gnang*/ bal pos sho lo kar bkod pa rdzogs so// jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du gsung rab rnams gzigs pas/ 'bum chung 'di kho na phan yon shin tu che bar 'dug pas/ phyi rabs kyi gang zag rnams kyis kyang*/ 'di la klog 'don byed pa gal che gsungs so// shu bhaṃ/// /
